title: Voxarian World
description: A modpack that combines some aspects of Create and Vulkarian skies while increasing the game's difficulty. Locked on hard mode.
body:
# Voxarian World:

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/H5WGt0G9/images/7bc728f9b05502b217db5fa91d362afad089aa28.png)

Voxarian World is a comprehensive Fabric modpack meticulously crafted for players seeking an incredibly rich, expansive, and challenging Minecraft experience. Prepare to dive into a world teeming with new structures, biome diversity, and deep gameplay systems, all underpinned by the industrial might of Create and the excitement of enhanced survival.

All problems can be reported at my discord server:
[Discord](https://discord.com/invite/CN5datVbF4)

## ⚙️ Core Experience:

- **The Age of Create:** At the heart of this pack is the Create mod ecosystem (including Create Fabric, Steam Rails, Diesel Generators, Interactive, Connected, etc.). Master complex contraptions, build massive automated factories, design intricate rail networks, and even take to the skies with Valkyrien Skies and Eureka for physics-based airship adventures!
- **A World Remade:** Explore a Minecraft landscape vastly improved and expanded. Experience the breathtaking diversity of Better End, and encounter epic new structures with Repurposed Structures and the entire Yung's Better series (Caves, Dungeons, Strongholds, Monuments, etc.).
- **Cosmic Journeys:** Beyond the Overworld, prepare for the stars! Launch rockets and explore new celestial bodies with Ad Astra and its addons, bringing a sci-fi space exploration layer to your gameplay.

## ⚔️ Combat & Survival:

- **Refined Melee & Ranged:** Engage in dynamic, skill-based fights with Better Combat and master new weapons with Weapon Master and the Ranged Weapon API. Utilize advanced utility gear like Sophisticated Backpacks for deeper storage.
- **Epic Gear & Magic:** Discover new armors, spells, and abilities with mods like Paladins, Epic Knights, Wizards, and Rogues, all powered by Spell Engine and Spell Power. Collect unique armor trims with Better Trim Tooltips.
- **True Survival:** Face a more engaging survival experience with mods like Tough As Nails (for thirst and temperature) and Dehydration.

## 🎨 Immersion & Aesthetics:

- **Visual Overhaul:** The world comes alive with stunning visual and audio enhancements. Enjoy beautiful ambient sounds (AmbientSounds, PresenceFootsteps), dynamic lighting (Dynamic Lights), weather effects (Immersive Thunder, Dynamic Surroundings), and custom animations (Eating Animation, Player Animation Lib). Use the included performance and rendering mods (Sodium, Iris, Indium, Continuity) for a smooth, high-fidelity experience.
- **Interior Decor:** Fill your builds with personality using new furniture and decorative options from Handcrafted and Another Furniture.
- **Explore Limitlessly:** Utilize Distant Horizons to see breathtaking vistas and far-off structures that truly make the world feel infinite.

## ✨ Quality of Life & Utilities

Manage your vast inventory and complex recipes with essential tools like EMI (with all its helpful addons), Jade for quick block info, and Controlling for keybind management. Stay on track with Xaero's Minimap and World Map.

**Voxarian World is an integrated experience where every mod works together to create a cohesive, challenging, and unforgettable adventure.**
